_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); gas distribution and midstream signals with ONEOK's rule-T thresholds

pit_profile.why: 'We are a leading midstream service provider and own one of the nation’s premier natural gas liquids systems, connecting NGL supply in the Mid-Continent, Permian and Rocky Mountain regions with key market centers and an extensive network of natural gas gathering, processing, storage and transportation assets.' 'We operate primarily fee-based businesses in each of our three reportable segments, and our consolidated earnings were nearly 90 percent fee-based in 2018.' 'The volatility of natural gas, crude oil and NGL prices could affect adversely our earnings and cash flows.' (the FY2018 10-K's own words; it does not use the word cyclical, so DURABLE, the MU rule); no disruption theme in the registry is live for a midstream company on this date (of the live themes, OFFSHORE is scoped to 'lower-cost offshore delivery (Indian IT services) takes share and price from Western consulting, systems integration and outsourcing', CLOUD to 'public cloud displaces on-premise hardware, storage, legacy databases and data-center outsourcing', ECOMMERCE to 'e-commerce (Amazon effect) displaces physical retail, malls, grocery, distribution', STREAMING to 'cord-cutting / streaming displaces linear TV networks and pay-TV bundles', ENERGY_TRANSITION to 'decarbonisation strands oil, gas and coal reserves and refining': none names gas distribution or midstream), so the watch list is empty; ENERGY_TRANSITION's reserves and refining are out of scope (the TRGP and BKR reading): ONEOK holds no reserves of its own and refines nothing ('We may not be able to accurately estimate hydrocarbon reserves and production volumes expected to be delivered to us for a variety of reasons, including the unavailability of sufficiently detailed information and unanticipated changes in producers’ expected drilling schedules.'); its greenhouse gas risk factor: 'We may face significant costs to comply with the regulation of GHG emissions.' (text only)

BEAR.desc: EPS -52.9%/yr (worst year FY09-FY18, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS -24.4%/yr (Q4 revenues + margin + buyback); P/E at its 10-yr median

BULL.desc: EPS +7.9%/yr (FY09-FY18 CAGR, at least BASE); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +45.6%/yr (best 2-yr run FY09-FY18, at least BULL); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: OKE (retrospective, 2019-03-15) ◎ ACCUMULATE — Ratio B 0.80x (83.5% downside to Bear $11 / +104.9% upside to Bull $137) | Adj composite 2.65 vs market 2.25: gap +0.40 [MODESTLY UNDERVALUED] | -9% above the EPP floor $73 (24x FY19E $3.06) | Conservative 2-yr case: +57.0% total (+28.5%/yr) | At 21.9x FY19E the 15% hurdle price $88 sits between the BASE and BULL cases; net margin +13.9% and Distribution operating income n/r in Q4 2018, forward revenues -17.3% (no FY19 revenue guide in numbers, Q4 2018 revenues as reported); no theme in the registry is live for a midstream company on this date (CLOUD and OFFSHORE are scoped to IT, ECOMMERCE to retail, STREAMING to TV, ENERGY_TRANSITION to reserves and refining).
